headline: Bitcoin is flat near $76,000 on Saturday after US bitcoin funds lost $1.28B over the week, with Tuesday's US inflation report the next big test.

market.asOf: From CoinGecko at about 11:57-11:59 UTC Sat 7 Nov (18:57 Bangkok). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Fear: the Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index read 28 (Fear) and CoinMarketCap's Fear & Greed read 32, both at about 12:00 UTC Sat 7 Nov.

stories.title: Bitcoin flat near $76,000 after US bitcoin funds lose $1.28B in a week
stories.summary: Bitcoin has barely moved on Saturday after a weak week. A much stronger than expected US jobs report raised the odds of a Fed rate hike in December, and US spot bitcoin funds lost money on four of the week's five trading days. Tuesday's inflation report is the next big data point.
points: Bitcoin was $75,926.73 on CoinDesk at 6:53am ET Saturday, down 0.16% over 24 hours.
US spot bitcoin funds lost a net $1.28B over the week of 2-6 Nov, including $411.9M on Friday; BlackRock's IBIT lost $1.21B over the week, per crypto.news citing Farside data.
US payrolls rose 165,000 in October and unemployment fell to 4.1%, per InvestmentNews.
Odds of a December rate hike were 76.8% on CME FedWatch after the jobs data, per InvestmentNews.

stories.title: MEXC says it is operating normally after the US Treasury orders a cut-off
stories.summary: The US Treasury moved to cut crypto exchange MEXC off from the US financial system, alleging about $16B of flows linked to Iran, North Korea and Russia. MEXC says assets are secure and services are operating normally.
points: The Treasury alleges about $16B of transactions connected to Iran, North Korea and Russia went through MEXC, per The Block.
MEXC says assets are secure and services are operating normally, per The Defiant.

sources.label: The Block: Treasury cuts off MEXC
The Defiant: MEXC says withdrawals continue

stories.title: Binance hack: plan to reopen six more withdrawals by end of next week
stories.summary: Binance's Richard Teng confirmed the plan to reopen withdrawals for six more coins by the end of next week. Blockchain analysts at Elliptic say the hackers are slowly converting stolen coins into bitcoin, but only a negligible amount has likely been cashed out.
points: Binance aims to reopen HYPE, INJ, APT, PLASMA, NEAR and LTC withdrawals by the end of next week, per The Coin Republic.
About $3.11B sits in addresses linked to the theft, $2.85B is frozen and $470M is unaccounted for, per The Block citing Elliptic.
About $124M of stolen tokens has been swapped into bitcoin, across more than 20,000 wallets on 16 blockchains, per The Block.
The Block puts the total breach at $6.43B, citing Elliptic.

sources.label: The Coin Republic: Teng confirms withdrawal timeline
The Block: hackers swap $124M into bitcoin

briefs.title: Ether ETFs lose $365M over the week
briefs.summary: US spot ether funds lost a net $365.2M over the week of 2-6 Nov, including $93.3M on Friday, per crypto.news citing Farside data.

briefs.title: Binance France to close all accounts on 31 Dec
briefs.summary: Binance France will close all accounts on 31 December after failing to secure an EU licence, and will charge monthly fees from 29 November, per Bitcoin.com News.

briefs.title: Nubank and Mercado Pago pause crypto transfers
briefs.summary: Brazil's Nubank halted crypto deposits and withdrawals and Mercado Pago partly blocked transfers, both citing a problem at an outside provider, per PYMNTS.

briefs.title: Treasury drops $250 crypto Travel Rule plan
briefs.summary: FinCEN and the Fed withdrew a 2020 proposal to lower the threshold for collecting transfer data from $3,000 to $250, per The Block.

briefs.title: Strive posts a $509M quarterly profit on bitcoin
briefs.summary: Strive reported Q3 net income of $509M, driven by paper gains on its bitcoin, and now holds 43,124 BTC, per The Block.

calendar.note: The new rules could remove Strategy from MSCI indexes, per The Block. Changes take effect after the 30 Nov close, per DL News. Release time not confirmed. Veterans Day.

calendar.note: Claims expected 195K, prior 189K, per Trading Economics. Gemini reports results after the US close.

calendar.note: About $3.08B notional (40,491 BTC) across Deribit, OKX and Bybit, put/call ratio 0.77, per CryptoKeyhole data as of 6 Nov.

calendar.note: Both listed on the Fed's November calendar.

The Fed held at 3.75-4.00% on 28 Oct in a 10-2 vote; Cook and Hammack dissented in favour of a hike, per Fortune. After the jobs report, December hike odds were 76.8% on CME FedWatch, per InvestmentNews.
